name: Unchained Monk Monk of Many Worlds
body:
A monk of many worlds has an innate connection to many planes or dimensions. They take that innate power and practice a martial art that allows them to slide in and out of existence.

Planar Combatant (Ex)

At 1st level, a monk of many worlds gains Bluff and Knowledge (planes) as class skills, but they lose Knowledge (history), Knowledge (religion), and Ride as class skills.

Phasing Strike (Su)

At 1st level, a monk of many worlds can make an attack that phases through planes and through their opponent’s defenses. As a swift action, the monk of many worlds can make a feint attempt with a bonus to the attempt equal to 1/2 their class level. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their class level.

At 6th level, the strike is always considered to have the ghost touch property when this ability is used.

At 12th level, all of a monk of many worlds’ unarmed attacks have the ghost touch property.

This ability replaces stunning fist.

Dimension Slip (Su)

Beginning with 3rd level, a monk of many worlds can shift 5 feet into any unoccupied space as an immediate or swift action. If this shift would put them beyond the range of an attack or area of effect, they are unaffected but the attack is still made, if applicable. This ability is usable once per day plus 1 per 3 levels after 3rd. This ability replaces fast movement.

Dimensional Charge (Su)

Starting with 4th level, a monk of many worlds can slip between dimensions while making a charge. This allows them to triple their speed on a full-round charge attack.

At 12th level, a monk of many worlds does not suffer the AC penalty from charging and may turn any number of times while charging.

This ability replaces all instances of slow fall for the monk and the ki powers gained at 4th and 12th levels for the unchained monk.

Far Strike (Su)

At 6th level, a monk of many worlds can open a small gate with an attack. They may make a single attack as a full-round action to attack a creature within 30 feet. At 12th level, this increases to 60 feet.

This attack can be modified by Vital Strike or its improvements. This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 6th level.

Dimensional Jump (Sp)

At 10th level, a monk of many worlds can cast dimension door as a spell-like ability using their class level as the caster level. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier. This ability replaces the bonus feat at 10th level, and diamond body for the monk, or the 10th-level ki power for the unchained monk.

Multi-Dimensional Strike (Su)

At 15th level, a monk of many worlds can make their attacks through a dimensional portal they create and use their full attack or flurry of blows to attack any creature within 30 feet.

The attacks can target multiple creatures or the same creature at their discretion. These attacks automatically gain the free feint attempt from the phasing strike ability. This ability is usable a number of times equal to their Wisdom modifier. This ability replaces quivering palm for the monk, or all instances of style strike for the unchained monk.
